## Recopy v1.12.2 - Keys Work Without a Click

A fix release for macOS: the panel takes keyboard input again as soon as it opens, even after you have been typing in another app.

### Fixes

- **macOS:** after you typed in another app's text field, opening the panel with the shortcut left the arrow keys, Enter, Escape and typing unresponsive until you clicked the panel. Shortcuts such as ⌘Q still worked, so the panel looked focused when it wasn't. The panel now hands keyboard focus to its content every time it opens. This regression appeared in v1.12.0 with the Tauri 2.12 update.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Recopy_1.12.2_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `Recopy_1.12.2_x64.dmg` |
| Windows (64-bit) | `Recopy_1.12.2_x64-setup.exe` |

### Notes

- **macOS:** The app is not notarized yet. On first launch: right-click → Open → confirm. See the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md).
- No database changes relative to v1.12.1.
- Windows is unaffected by this fix; the change only touches the macOS panel.
- Verified: 421 frontend tests, 97 Rust tests (one opt-in performance test skipped), Rust lint checks, CI build checks for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows x64, and hands-on testing of the fix on macOS (Apple Silicon). Intel Mac hardware was not tested.

## Recopy v1.12.2 - 打开面板即可用键盘

macOS 修复版本：即使刚在其他应用里打过字，面板一打开也能直接用键盘操作。

### 修复

- **macOS：** 在其他应用的输入框里打字后，再用快捷键打开面板，方向键、Enter、Esc 和输入都没有反应，必须先点一下面板才能用。期间 ⌘Q 等快捷键仍然有效，所以面板看起来像是有焦点，实际上并没有。现在面板每次打开都会把键盘焦点交给面板内容。这个问题是 v1.12.0 升级 Tauri 2.12 时引入的。

### 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple Silicon） | `Recopy_1.12.2_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `Recopy_1.12.2_x64.dmg` |
| Windows（64 位） | `Recopy_1.12.2_x64-setup.exe` |

### 说明

- **macOS：** 应用尚未公证。首次打开：右键 → 打开 → 确认。详见[安装指南](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md)。
- 相比 v1.12.1，数据库没有变化。
- 本次修复只涉及 macOS 面板，Windows 不受影响。
- 验证情况：421 项前端测试、97 项 Rust 测试（跳过一项按需运行的性能测试）、Rust 代码检查、CI 中 macOS（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）和 Windows x64 的构建检查，以及在 macOS（Apple Silicon）上对此修复的实机测试。未进行 Intel Mac 实机测试。
